mechanism: Estradiol increases thyroid-binding globulin (TBG) levels, which may increase propylthiouracil protein binding and potentially reduce free drug levels, requiring higher PTU doses to maintain therapeutic efficacy in hypothyroid patients.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4) closely when initiating, adjusting, or discontinuing estradiol in patients on propylthiouracil, and adjust PTU dosing accordingly to maintain euthyroid state.
